FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD
NOTIFICATION
No. C.3005/2026
Pursuant to the High Court Notification No. C.3005/2026/01 dated
21.04.2026, inviting applications from _ eligible Advocates for
empowerment as Commissioner of Oaths for the High Court of Gujarat at
Ahmedabad, for vacancy of O9 posts, all the Advocates and_ their
concerned clerks are requested to take note that under Rule 7 of the
Commissioner of Oaths for the High Court of Gujarat Rules, 2024,
following advocates have been empowered to function and perform duties
as Commissioner of Oaths for the High Court of Gujarat for a period of
two years with effect from the date of this Notification:
Sr.
No.
Ol. |Ms. Poojaben Maheshbhai Panchal |Chamber No. 121, Lawyers
Chamber, 1* Floor, Gujarat High
Court, S.G.Highway, Sola,
Ahmedabad — 380060.
O2. |Mr. Sandip Ashokbhai Kapadiya Chamber No. 1014, C/o.Ravindra
Deshmukh, New Chamber
Building, Gujarat High Court, Sola,
Ahmedabad — 380060.
Name of the Advocate Work Place Address
O03. |Mr. Shatrughnbhai Sevantilal Soni |Chamber No. 421, C/o.
Hirenkumar M. _ Niyalchandani,
Gujarat High Court, Sola,
Ahmedabad — 380060.
They shall make their services available during court hours at the
Bar Room in the High Court.
HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT, BY ORDER
SOLA, AHMEDABAD-380 O60.
Ci

REGISTRAR GENERAL

HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT, BY ORDER
